WeaponTraitDef.label: gorging
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona feeds on violence, and it shares the meal. Whenever it kills or downs someone, its wielder feels a wave of warm fullness - real nourishment, and a little extra weight to show for it.

li.label: fed by my weapon
li.description: My weapon shared what it took. Warm, full, and a little heavier.
